greet.speaker: Margaret
greet.text: Thursday already. I swept the walk, but that front step still rocks if you catch it wrong.

problem.speaker: Margaret
problem.text: The spare key ring is off its hook. I won't lock the office over a missing ring.

sent_harold.speaker: Margaret
sent_harold.text: He's in the sanctuary, fretting the office lock. Ask him before he orders new hardware.

sent_search.speaker: Margaret
sent_search.text: Try the stacked chairs along the west wall. Harold sets things down and calls it sorted.

busy.speaker: Margaret
busy.text: The ring is still missing. Sanctuary first. I have bulletins to fold.

return_harold.speaker: Margaret
return_harold.text: He told you where they were. Good. I'll put them on the hook, not where Harold calls orderly. There's an old key on here that fits nothing. Pastor Reece kept that one on him.

return_search.speaker: Margaret
return_search.text: You found them without a committee. I'll take that. Harold will say he knew all along. There's an old key on here that fits nothing. Pastor Reece kept that one on him.

send_town.speaker: Margaret
send_town.text: Keys are on the hook. The front step still rocks. Thomas, at the hardware store on Oak Street, keeps the screws that fit it.

remind_hardware.speaker: Margaret
remind_hardware.text: Oak Street is east, past the lot. Ask Thomas about the step.

remind_frank.speaker: Margaret
remind_frank.text: Frank's bay is the next door down from the hardware store. Hear him out.

remind_friday.speaker: Margaret
remind_friday.text: Friday morning, Sarah is usually on Oak Street. She has about an hour before the kids.

remind_saturday.speaker: Margaret
remind_saturday.text: Come back Saturday evening. I'll be on the front walk.

saturday_wait.speaker: Margaret
saturday_wait.text: Not yet. Saturday evening, on the walk. I want the week in one piece before Sunday.

saturday_listened.speaker: Margaret
saturday_listened.text: Frank didn't promise Sunday. He stayed and talked. I'll take that. Tomorrow, ten o'clock.

saturday_closed.speaker: Margaret
saturday_closed.text: Frank kept the bay door half down. He has his reasons. Tomorrow is Sunday, ten o'clock.

week_sunday.speaker: Margaret
week_sunday.text: Sunday's at ten. I'm not asking for a crowd. I'm asking us to show up.

later_sunday.speaker: Margaret
later_sunday.text: No sermon this morning. We can sit with what we already said. The room does not need filling.

after_walk.speaker: Margaret
after_walk.text: The first week is behind us. Walk if you want. Nothing new is due today.
